## Safety checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (including failure and denial paths)
- [ ] No permission is granted implicitly; defaults still deny
- [ ] No secret can reach a sandbox, a log or an error message
- [ ] Docs / ADR updated if behaviour or the threat model changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
